name: Sharkline Reprieve 18' x 52" Round
description: The Sharkline Reprieve incorporates galvanized steel walls and an attractive pearl frame for unrivaled sophistication and dependability. A distinguished above ground pool, the Sharkline Reprieve is a great option for first time pool owners. The Reprieve has sturdy vertical uprights and interlocking top rails for unbeatable support. Equipped with a Flo-Pro II wide mouth skimmer for superior debris filtration, it accommodates an easy fit, one-piece resin cap design and is protected by five layers of galvanization to prevent its steel exterior from rusting. The Sharkline Reprieve is proudly manufactured in the USA and is a great do-it-yourself project that can be constructed in a weekend. Liners may be purchased separately by going to our Pool Liners section or selected in our Above Ground Pool Builder Section.
